liam: Heads up — CI perf job is ~35% slower after merge rfc/heuristic-refactor. Noticed in nightly perf-run for textgen.
ci-bot: PERF RUN: runtime-integ #4321 — p50 +35%, p95 +12%. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/4321
susan: Ugh. Starting a quick bisect. My hunch is the kernel selection changes; that patch tweaked thresholds.
maya: Ran a quick local flamegraph. Seeing a compile-queue spike and repeated kernel compilations for identical model shards. Looks like KV cache keys are being invalidated frequently.
kevin: I can repro on my laptop with --batch=16. Logs show repeated: "compiling kernel: aten_matmul_f16_v2" 6x within same workload.
liam: That smells like the heuristic chose a different kernel variant and didn't reuse cached compiled binaries.
susan: git bisect points to commit abc1234 (heuristics: pick-by-latency -> pick-by-dynamic-score). That change updates the scoring but also the cache key generation.
maya: Confirmed. Cache key now includes the new "score_bucket" field which flips frequently for mid-length sequences, causing cache churn.
kevin: Quick repro patch: replace cache key generation to ignore score_bucket and perf returns to baseline locally.
maya: Paste of the offending diff (redacted):
```
- key = f"{model_id}:{arch}:{score_bucket}:{seq_len}"
+ key = f"{model_id}:{arch}:{seq_len}"
```
susan: That explains repeated compiles. Also saw a "compile storm" where 20 nodes tried to compile same kernel within 2m after rollout.
liam: This is a rollout blocker. Can we revert the commit or ship a small fix?
deploy-bot: Rollback option: revert commit abc1234 in canary. Note: dedicated infra has active jobs, rollback window in ~15m. Opening infra ticket INF-987.
maya: I prepared a tiny patch to stable: pin the cache key to legacy form and add a metric to track score_bucket flips. Patch: `runtime: cache: ignore dynamic score in key` (PR #789).
susan: Running a focused perf job with the patch now. If it shows p50 back to baseline I'll push to canary and then prod.
kevin: If we revert, let's also add a test that simulates frequent score changes to catch this in CI.
liam: Agreed. Add a regression test + a perf guard. Marking as rollout-blocker :sos: — thanks all, keep updates here.
ci-bot: PERF RUN queued: runtime-integ #4322 (with patch) — will post results.
